test_sequence: Use battery emulator and current-limited bench supply before any real battery.
Start with 10kohm at TH1; sweep upward through cold boundary and back.
Return to 10kohm; sweep downward through hot boundary and back.
Check sensor open/short and startup/brownout separately; record charge current and guard gate.
limits: Boundary ranges include only three independent 1% divider resistor errors.
Comparator offset, hysteresis, common-mode dependence, leakage and rail variation excluded.
These are sweep starting points, not acceptance temperatures or guaranteed switching resistances.
No measured data; sensor thermal coupling and cell protection unqualified.
Alternative NTCAFLEX is not adopted by this output.
